biography: Andrew Davis, born in the heartland of America, didn't inherit racing royalty. His journey began not on a karting track, but on the dusty backroads of his family's farm. At 16, trading labor for laps, he discovered a raw talent for controlling speed on a beat-up go-kart his uncle had salvaged. His family pooled resources to get him into regional series, where he quickly rose through the ranks, his calculated aggression earning him both wins and detractors. A defining moment came at the SCCA National Championship Runoffs, where a daring last-lap overtake cemented his reputation as a driver willing to risk it all. Now, well into his thirties, Davis finds himself with Mercedes-AMG, battling younger talent. While flashes of brilliance remain, consistency has waned, and whispers of retirement are growing louder.
drivingStyle: Davis is a cerebral driver, known for his meticulous preparation and data analysis. He doesn't rely on raw aggression, but rather on exploiting subtle weaknesses in his competitors' lines and car setups. He's a master of tire management, often nursing his rubber through long stints while others fade. While he can be ruthless in wheel-to-wheel combat, his approach is always calculated, weighing risk versus reward with a cold, almost detached demeanor. He excels in endurance racing, where his consistency and tactical awareness shine.

rivalries.name: Marco Bellini
rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision in the 2018 Sebring 12 Hours, where Davis was accused of deliberately running Bellini off the track.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Moreau
rivalries.reason: A clash of personalities and driving styles. Moreau, the young, flamboyant prodigy, openly dismisses Davis as 'old and boring,' while Davis views Moreau as reckless and undisciplined.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: A rivalry based on mutual respect but intense competition. Tanaka's precision and technical skill mirror Davis's own, leading to constant battles for tenths of a second.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of worn-out driving gloves, claiming they bring him luck.
Obsessively cleans his helmet visor before every session, regardless of how clean it already is.
Refuses to speak to anyone for 30 minutes before a race, preferring to visualize the opening laps in complete silence.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about feeling; it's about knowing. Know your car, know your opponents, and know yourself. The rest is just physics."
careerHighlight: Winning the 24 Hours of Daytona in 2015, co-driving with two relative unknowns, proving his ability to elevate the performance of his teammates and secure a victory against all odds.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final hour of the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2019, costing his team a likely victory and shattering his hopes of completing the Triple Crown of endurance racing.
